requirements.statement: The device attaches to a machine and records vibration for analysis.
requirements.verificationMethod: Attach the device to the target machine and confirm it records vibration data suitable for later comparison.

requirements.statement: The vibration records allow the user to detect changes in how the machine is operating.
requirements.verificationMethod: Collect vibration recordings during two distinct operating conditions and confirm the recorded data supports change-detection reasoning in a later analysis step.

requirements.statement: The system shall capture timestamped vibration records so machine operating states can be compared later.
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm vibration logs include timestamps and can be exported/processed consistently for later comparison.

requirements.statement: The system must support the required vibration frequency range (measurement bandwidth unknown in this phase).
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm the required vibration frequency range before selecting any measurement approach.

requirements.statement: The system must support a target sampling rate and recording mode suitable for machine monitoring (sampling/recording mode unknown in this phase).

sourceReference.sourceLocator: sampling rate / recording mode not specified

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm sampling rate and whether recordings should be continuous vs triggered by change events.

requirements.statement: The system must accommodate the required dynamic range / acceleration range so vibration changes can be captured without saturating (dynamic range unknown in this phase).

sourceReference.sourceLocator: dynamic range / acceleration range not specified

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm the dynamic range requirements before selecting any measurement approach.

requirements.statement: The system must define mounting constraints and a baseline/calibration approach so vibration recordings can be compared across operating conditions (mounting/baseline unknown in this phase).

sourceReference.sourceLocator: mounting effects and baseline comparison method not specified

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm how the device will be mounted and how baseline/monitoring comparisons should be performed for change detection.

content.requirementSummary: The vibration-monitoring device must attach to a machine, record vibration, and enable detecting operating changes, while confirming open measurement-bandwidth, dynamic-range, recording-mode, and mounting/baseline calibration constraints before component selection.
missingDimensions: sampling rate and continuous vs triggered recording mode
recording duration and baseline collection schedule
